launcherMode.description: Choose whether games start through an installed XXMI Launcher or the built-in runtime. Settings for both are kept when you switch.

launchGuard.enabledDescription: Checks for settings that keep mods from applying or slow the game down before starting it. When off, the game starts without any of the checks below.

launchGuard.loggingDescription: Asks to turn 3DMigoto logging off before starting. Logging can slow the game down severely.
